note: All media tools route through OpenRouter. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY before any generation call. SKILL_DIR = the directory containing the Designer's SKILL.md (skills/designer); replace SKILL_DIR and PROJECT_DIR with resolved, quoted paths before running Bash. Full docs: each tool's own SKILL.md under SKILL_DIR/scripts/openrouter-*/.

text2music.purpose: Atmospheric sound-design / SFX (NOT the BGM). Generates ambient beds for sounds with no findable real recording — drones, textures, room tone; sharp foley (e.g. bullet-on-glass) is best-effort. The front-of-blog BGM must be a SOURCED real track (sourced_bgm via Scout), never generated here. Reader-controlled, event/section-bound, opt-in.
text2music.default_model: google/lyria-3-pro-preview (sound-design / SFX, not TTS, not the front BGM)
text2music.prompt_guidance: Describe the texture, not a song: e.g. "low rumbling tension drone, sub-bass swell, no melody" or "sharp glass-shatter texture, brittle high transients".
text2music.call: python3 SKILL_DIR/scripts/openrouter-text2music/scripts/generate_music.py --prompt "low rumbling tension drone, no melody" --download PROJECT_DIR/assets/sfx.wav
